concepts.label: Cell Membrane Physiology
concepts.summary: How molecules cross the lipid bilayer via passive diffusion, facilitated transport, and ATP-driven active pumps.

concepts.label: Action Potential
concepts.summary: Rapid voltage swing across an excitable cell driven by sequential opening of sodium and potassium channels.

concepts.label: Cardiac Output
concepts.summary: Volume of blood pumped per minute, governed by preload, afterload, contractility, and heart rate.

concepts.label: Nephron Physiology
concepts.summary: Functional unit of the kidney that filters plasma and selectively reabsorbs water and solutes to form urine.

concepts.label: Acid-Base Balance
concepts.summary: How lungs and kidneys cooperate to keep arterial pH near 7.4 via CO2 and bicarbonate handling.

concepts.label: Inflammation Cascade
concepts.summary: Innate immune response involving vasodilation, leukocyte recruitment, and cytokine release at sites of injury or infection.

concepts.label: Hemostasis
concepts.summary: Sequential platelet plug formation and coagulation cascade that stops bleeding and lays down fibrin clot.

concepts.label: Glucose Homeostasis
concepts.summary: Tight regulation of blood glucose by insulin (lowers) and glucagon (raises) acting on liver and peripheral tissues.

concepts.label: Hypertension
concepts.summary: Chronically elevated arterial blood pressure that increases risk of stroke, MI, and renal failure.

concepts.label: Coronary Artery Disease
concepts.summary: Atherosclerotic narrowing of coronary arteries causing angina and predisposing to myocardial infarction.

concepts.label: Heart Failure
concepts.summary: Inability of the heart to maintain adequate cardiac output, presenting with dyspnea, edema, and fatigue.

concepts.label: Atrial Fibrillation
concepts.summary: Disorganized atrial electrical activity producing an irregularly irregular pulse and elevated stroke risk.

concepts.label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
concepts.summary: Chronic hyperglycemia from insulin resistance and progressive beta-cell dysfunction.

concepts.label: Chronic Kidney Disease
concepts.summary: Progressive irreversible loss of nephron function, commonly secondary to diabetes and hypertension.

concepts.label: Community-Acquired Pneumonia
concepts.summary: Lower respiratory infection acquired outside the hospital, most often from Strep pneumoniae or atypicals.

concepts.label: Sepsis
concepts.summary: Life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection.

concepts.label: DVT and Pulmonary Embolism
concepts.summary: Venous thromboembolism in deep leg veins that can dislodge and obstruct pulmonary arteries.

concepts.label: Ischemic Stroke
concepts.summary: Sudden focal neurologic deficit caused by occlusion of a cerebral artery by thrombus or embolus.

concepts.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
concepts.summary: Progressive airflow limitation from chronic bronchitis and emphysema, strongly linked to tobacco smoking.

concepts.label: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
concepts.summary: Reflux of gastric contents into the esophagus causing heartburn, regurgitation, and mucosal injury.

concepts.label: Beta Blockers
concepts.summary: Drugs that antagonize beta-adrenergic receptors to lower heart rate, contractility, and blood pressure.

concepts.label: ACE Inhibitors and ARBs
concepts.summary: Renin-angiotensin blockers that lower blood pressure and protect kidneys in diabetes and heart failure.

concepts.label: Statins
concepts.summary: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors that lower LDL cholesterol and reduce cardiovascular events.

concepts.label: Diuretics (Loop, Thiazide, K-sparing)
concepts.summary: Drugs acting at distinct nephron segments to increase urine output and manage volume and blood pressure.

concepts.label: Anticoagulants (DOAC, Warfarin, Heparin)
concepts.summary: Agents that interrupt the coagulation cascade to prevent or treat venous and arterial thromboembolism.

concepts.label: Beta-Lactam Antibiotics
concepts.summary: Penicillins and cephalosporins that inhibit bacterial cell wall synthesis via transpeptidase binding.

concepts.label: Fluoroquinolones and Macrolides
concepts.summary: Antibiotics targeting bacterial DNA gyrase (FQ) or the 50S ribosome (macrolides), used for atypical pneumonia.

concepts.label: Metformin
concepts.summary: First-line oral biguanide for type 2 diabetes that reduces hepatic gluconeogenesis and improves insulin sensitivity.

concepts.label: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
concepts.summary: Incretin mimetics that augment insulin release, suppress glucagon, slow gastric emptying, and promote weight loss.

concepts.label: SSRIs and SNRIs
concepts.summary: First-line antidepressants that block reuptake of serotonin (SSRI) or serotonin and norepinephrine (SNRI).
